# Trump approval takes another hit: Poll

President Trump’s approval rating dipped again this week, following a downward trend in support for the president amid the ongoing Iran war and mounting affordability concerns ahead of November’s midterms.

The latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, published Monday, found 33 percent of respondents said they approved of how Trump has handled his job as president. Another 62 percent indicated they disapproved. [...] Support for the president was split largely along partisan lines, with 79 percent of GOP respondents and only 4 percent of Democratic respondents approving of Trump’s job performance, according to the poll.

results.title: Trump approval takes another hit: Poll

results.content:
In the latest Economist/YouGov survey, Trump is exiting August with a 33 percent approval rating, a new low for him in that poll.

Trump’s polling in the Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ) average did see a slight increase Thursday, reaching 39.2 percent.

Still, this average marked the second-lowest released by DDHQ since May, when Trump averaged 38 percent. The polling average also found that 57.5 percent disapproved of the president.
results.title: Trump’s approval ratings endure a cruel summer

results.content: A new Economist/YouGov poll, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump's job performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025. [...] The Economist/YouGov poll also found that 60% of Americans view the president as "not honest and trustworthy." Trump's age continues to concern many Americans, with 53% saying they believe the 80-year-old president is too old to serve in the White House. Additionally, 69% said they feel that things in the country are "out of control."
